#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""IPL 2026 Ball-by-Ball Analytics Report Generator."""

import base64
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df = pd.read_csv('/app/benchmark/data.csv')

# ── Preprocessing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df['over_int'] = df['over'].astype(int)
df['total_runs'] = df['runs_of_bat'] + df['extras']
df['is_legal'] = (df['wide'] == 0) & (df['noballs'] == 0)
df['is_dot'] = (df['runs_of_bat'] == 0) & (df['extras'] == 0)
df['is_boundary'] = df['runs_of_bat'].isin([4, 6])
df['is_four'] = df['runs_of_bat'] == 4
df['is_six'] = df['runs_of_bat'] == 6
df['is_wicket'] = df['wicket_type'].astype(str).str.strip() != ''
df['phase'] = pd.cut(df['over_int'], bins=[-1, 5, 14, 19],
                     labels=['Powerplay (1-6)', 'Middle Overs (7-15)', 'Death Overs (16-20)'])

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def fig_to_base64(fig, dpi=130):
    buf = BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=dpi, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    plt.close(fig)
    buf.seek(0)
    return base64.b64encode(buf.read()).decode('utf-8')

DARK   = '#1a1a2e'
ACCENT = '#e94560'
BLUE   = '#0f3460'
TEAL   = '#16c79a'
GOLD   = '#f5a623'
GREY   = '#6b7280'

TEAM_COLORS = {
    'SRH': '#f5a623', 'RCB': '#e94560', 'CSK': '#f5c518', 'MI': '#004ba0',
    'DC': '#004c99', 'KKR': '#3a225d', 'PBKS': '#dd1f2d', 'RR': '#ea1a85',
    'GT': '#1c1c2b', 'LSG': '#a72056'
}

def style_ax(ax, title='', xlabel='', ylabel=''):
    ax.set_facecolor('#fafafa')
    if title:
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=DARK, pad=10)
    if xlabel:
        ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=10, color=GREY)
    if ylabel:
        ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=10, color=GREY)
    ax.tick_params(colors=GREY, labelsize=9)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color('#e0e0e0')
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

def df_to_html_table(dataframe, max_rows=None):
    if max_rows:
        dataframe = dataframe.head(max_rows)
    return dataframe.to_html(index=False, border=0, classes='data-table',
                              float_format='%.2f', escape=False)

# ── KPIs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
total_matches = df['match_no'].nunique()
total_deliveries = len(df)
legal_deliveries = int(df['is_legal'].sum())
total_overs = legal_deliveries / 6
total_runs = int(df['total_runs'].sum())
total_bat_runs = int(df['runs_of_bat'].sum())
total_extras = int(df['extras'].sum())
total_wickets = int(df['is_wicket'].sum())
total_boundaries = int(df['is_boundary'].sum())
total_dots = int(df['is_dot'].sum())
total_fours = int(df['is_four'].sum())
total_sixes = int(df['is_six'].sum())

kpi_avg_rpo = round(total_runs / total_overs, 2)
kpi_boundary_pct = round(total_boundaries / total_deliveries * 100, 2)
kpi_dot_pct = round(total_dots / total_deliveries * 100, 2)
kpi_extras_per_match = round(total_extras / total_matches, 2)
kpi_wickets_per_match = round(total_wickets / total_matches, 2)

# ── Tournament Overview ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
venues_count = df['venue'].nunique()
teams = sorted(set(df['batting_team'].unique()) | set(df['bowling_team'].unique()))
num_teams = len(teams)

# ── Batting Analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bat_stats = df.groupby('striker').agg(
    runs=('runs_of_bat', 'sum'),
    balls=('is_legal', 'sum'),
    fours=('is_four', 'sum'),
    sixes=('is_six', 'sum'),
    dismissals=('is_wicket', 'sum')
).reset_index()
bat_stats['strike_rate'] = (bat_stats['runs'] / bat_stats['balls'] * 100).round(2)
bat_stats['boundary_pct'] = ((bat_stats['fours'] + bat_stats['sixes']) / bat_stats['balls'] * 100).round(2)
bat_stats = bat_stats[bat_stats['balls'] >= 6]
top_batters = bat_stats.sort_values('runs', ascending=False).head(15)

# Phase-wise batting
phase_bat = df.groupby('phase', observed=False).agg(
    runs=('runs_of_bat', 'sum'),
    balls=('is_legal', 'sum'),
    boundaries=('is_boundary', 'sum'),
    dots=('is_dot', 'sum'),
    wickets=('is_wicket', 'sum')
).reset_index()
phase_bat['sr'] = (phase_bat['runs'] / phase_bat['balls'] * 100).round(2)
phase_bat['rpo'] = (phase_bat['runs'] / (phase_bat['balls'] / 6)).round(2)

# ── Bowling Analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bowl_stats = df.groupby('bowler').agg(
    runs_conceded=('total_runs', 'sum'),
    balls_bowled=('is_legal', 'sum'),
    dots_bowled=('is_dot', 'sum'),
    wickets=('is_wicket', 'sum'),
    fours_conceded=('is_four', 'sum'),
    sixes_conceded=('is_six', 'sum')
).reset_index()
bowl_stats['economy'] = (bowl_stats['runs_conceded'] / (bowl_stats['balls_bowled'] / 6)).round(2)
bowl_stats['dot_pct'] = (bowl_stats['dots_bowled'] / bowl_stats['balls_bowled'] * 100).round(2)
bowl_stats['avg'] = (bowl_stats['runs_conceded'] / bowl_stats['wickets'].replace(0, np.nan)).round(2)
bowl_stats = bowl_stats[bowl_stats['balls_bowled'] >= 6]
top_bowlers_wickets = bowl_stats.sort_values('wickets', ascending=False).head(15)
top_bowlers_economy = bowl_stats[bowl_stats['balls_bowled'] >= 18].sort_values('economy').head(15)

# Dismissal types
dismissal_types = df[df['is_wicket']]['wicket_type'].value_counts()

# Phase-wise bowling
phase_bowl = df.groupby('phase', observed=False).agg(
    runs_conceded=('total_runs', 'sum'),
    balls_bowled=('is_legal', 'sum'),
    dots_bowled=('is_dot', 'sum'),
    wickets=('is_wicket', 'sum')
).reset_index()
phase_bowl['economy'] = (phase_bowl['runs_conceded'] / (phase_bowl['balls_bowled'] / 6)).round(2)
phase_bowl['dot_pct'] = (phase_bowl['dots_bowled'] / phase_bowl['balls_bowled'] * 100).round(2)

# ── Team Comparison ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
team_bat = df.groupby('batting_team').agg(
    total_runs=('runs_of_bat', 'sum'),
    total_balls=('is_legal', 'sum'),
    total_fours=('is_four', 'sum'),
    total_sixes=('is_six', 'sum'),
    total_boundaries=('is_boundary', 'sum')
).reset_index()
team_bat['run_rate'] = (team_bat['total_runs'] / (team_bat['total_balls'] / 6)).round(2)
team_bat['boundary_pct'] = (team_bat['total_boundaries'] / team_bat['total_balls'] * 100).round(2)
team_innings_count = df.groupby('batting_team').agg(
    innings_count=('match_no', 'nunique')
).reset_index()
team_bat = team_bat.merge(team_innings_count, on='batting_team', how='left')
team_bat['avg_runs_per_innings'] = (team_bat['total_runs'] / team_bat['innings_count']).round(2)

team_bowl = df.groupby('bowling_team').agg(
    total_runs_conceded=('total_runs', 'sum'),
    total_wickets_taken=('is_wicket', 'sum'),
    total_balls_bowled=('is_legal', 'sum'),
    total_extras_given=('extras', 'sum'),
    total_dots=('is_dot', 'sum')
).reset_index()
team_bowl['economy'] = (team_bowl['total_runs_conceded'] / (team_bowl['total_balls_bowled'] / 6)).round(2)
team_bowl['dot_pct'] = (team_bowl['total_dots'] / team_bowl['total_balls_bowled'] * 100).round(2)
team_bowl_innings = df.groupby('bowling_team').agg(
    bowl_innings=('match_no', 'nunique')
).reset_index()
team_bowl = team_bowl.merge(team_bowl_innings, on='bowling_team', how='left')

<body>
<div class="container">

<div class="report-header">
  <h1>IPL 2026 Ball-by-Ball Analytics Report</h1>
  <div class="subtitle">A comprehensive delivery-level analysis of batting, bowling, extras, and dismissal patterns across the tournament</div>
  <div class="meta">Season 19 • Data through {total_matches} matches • {total_deliveries:,} deliveries analysed</div>
</div>

<div class="kpi-grid">

    <div class="kpi-label">Boundary Percentage</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card">
    <div class="kpi-value">{kpi_dot_pct}%</div>
    <div class="kpi-label">Dot Ball Percentage</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card">
    <div class="kpi-value">{kpi_extras_per_match}</div>
    <div class="kpi-label">Extras Per Match</div>
  </div>
  <div class="kpi-card">
    <div class="kpi-value">{kpi_wickets_per_match}</div>
    <div class="kpi-label">Wickets Per Match</div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="section">
  <h2>Tournament Overview & Match Summary</h2>
  <p>The 19th edition of the IPL commenced on March 28, 2026, featuring ten franchise teams competing across multiple venues. This analysis covers <strong>{total_matches} matches</strong> comprising <strong>{total_deliveries:,} deliveries</strong> ({total_overs:.1f} legal overs), producing <strong>{total_runs:,} total runs</strong> and <strong>{total_wickets} wickets</strong>.</p>

  <h3>Key Aggregates</h3>
  <table class="data-table">
    <tr><th>Metric</th><th>Value</th></tr>
    <tr><td>Matches Played</td><td>{total_matches}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Venues Used</td><td>{venues_count}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Teams Participating</td><td>{num_teams} ({teams_str})</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Total Deliveries</td><td>{total_deliveries:,}</td></tr>
    <tr><td>Legal Deliveries</td><td>{legal_deliveries:,}</td></tr>

    <tr><td>Total Extras</td><td>{total_extras:,}</td></tr>

  </div>
</div>

<div class="section">
  <h2>Batting Performance Analysis</h2>
  <p>Delivery-level data enables a granular view of individual and phase-wise batting performance. Below we rank the tournament's top run-scorers, examine strike rates, boundary frequency, and scoring acceleration across match phases.</p>

  </div>

  <h3>Scoring Patterns by Match Phase</h3>
  <p>The 20-over innings is divided into three tactical phases: <strong>Powerplay</strong> (overs 1-6), <strong>Middle Overs</strong> (overs 7-15), and <strong>Death Overs</strong> (overs 16-20). Scoring rates and boundary frequency vary significantly across these phases.</p>

  <div class="chart-container">

  </div>

  </div>

  <h3>Phase-wise Bowling Effectiveness</h3>
  <div class="chart-container">

  </div>

  </table>
</div>

<div class="section">
  <h2>Team Performance Comparison</h2>
  <p>Comparing batting and bowling units across teams reveals competitive edges and vulnerabilities. The following analysis examines run rates, boundary frequency, wicket-taking ability, and bowling economy at the team level.</p>

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""IPL 2026 Ball-by-Ball Analytics Report Generator."""

import base64
from io import BytesIO
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

# ── Load data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df = pd.read_csv('/app/benchmark/data.csv')

# ── Preprocessing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df['over_int'] = df['over'].astype(int)
df['total_runs'] = df['runs_of_bat'] + df['extras']
df['is_legal'] = (df['wide'] == 0) & (df['noballs'] == 0)
df['is_dot'] = (df['runs_of_bat'] == 0) & (df['extras'] == 0)
df['is_boundary'] = df['runs_of_bat'].isin([4, 6])
df['is_four'] = df['runs_of_bat'] == 4
df['is_six'] = df['runs_of_bat'] == 6
df['is_wicket'] = df['wicket_type'].astype(str).str.strip() != ''
df['phase'] = pd.cut(df['over_int'], bins=[-1, 5, 14, 19],
                     labels=['Powerplay (1-6)', 'Middle Overs (7-15)', 'Death Overs (16-20)'])

# ── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def fig_to_base64(fig, dpi=130):
    buf = BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format='png', dpi=dpi, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
    plt.close(fig)
    buf.seek(0)
    return base64.b64encode(buf.read()).decode('utf-8')

DARK   = '#1a1a2e'
ACCENT = '#e94560'
BLUE   = '#0f3460'
TEAL   = '#16c79a'
GOLD   = '#f5a623'
GREY   = '#6b7280'

TEAM_COLORS = {
    'SRH': '#f5a623', 'RCB': '#e94560', 'CSK': '#f5c518', 'MI': '#004ba0',
    'DC': '#004c99', 'KKR': '#3a225d', 'PBKS': '#dd1f2d', 'RR': '#ea1a85',
    'GT': '#1c1c2b', 'LSG': '#a72056'
}

def style_ax(ax, title='', xlabel='', ylabel=''):
    ax.set_facecolor('#fafafa')
    if title:
        ax.set_title(title, fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', color=DARK, pad=10)
    if xlabel:
        ax.set_xlabel(xlabel, fontsize=10, color=GREY)
    if ylabel:
        ax.set_ylabel(ylabel, fontsize=10, color=GREY)
    ax.tick_params(colors=GREY, labelsize=9)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color('#e0e0e0')
    ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

def df_to_html_table(dataframe, max_rows=None):
    if max_rows:
        dataframe = dataframe.head(max_rows)
    return dataframe.to_html(index=False, border=0, classes='data-table',
                              float_format='%.2f', escape=False)

# ── KPIs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
total_matches = df['match_no'].nunique()
total_deliveries = len(df)
legal_deliveries = int(df['is_legal'].sum())
total_overs = legal_deliveries / 6
total_runs = int(df['total_runs'].sum())
total_bat_runs = int(df['runs_of_bat'].sum())
total_extras = int(df['extras'].sum())
total_wickets = int(df['is_wicket'].sum())
total_boundaries = int(df['is_boundary'].sum())
total_dots = int(df['is_dot'].sum())
total_fours = int(df['is_four'].sum())
total_sixes = int(df['is_six'].sum())

kpi_avg_rpo = round(total_runs / total_overs, 2)
kpi_boundary_pct = round(total_boundaries / total_deliveries * 100, 2)
kpi_dot_pct = round(total_dots / total_deliveries * 100, 2)
kpi_extras_per_match = round(total_extras / total_matches, 2)
kpi_wickets_per_match = round(total_wickets / total_matches, 2)

# ── Tournament Overview ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
venues_count = df['venue'].nunique()
teams = sorted(set(df['batting_team'].unique()) | set(df['bowling_team'].unique()))
num_teams = len(teams)

# ── Batting Analysis ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
bat_stats = df.groupby('striker').agg(
    runs=('runs_of_bat', 'sum'),
    balls=('is_legal', 'sum'),
    fours=('is_four', 'sum'),
    sixes=('is_six', 'sum'),
    dismissals=('is_wicket', 'sum')
).reset_index()
bat_stats['strike_rate'] = (bat_stats['runs'] / bat_stats['balls'] * 100).round(2)
bat_stats['boundary_pct'] = ((bat_stats['fours'] + bat_stats['sixes']) / bat_stats['balls'] * 100).round(2)
bat_stats = bat_stats[bat_stats['balls'] >= 6]
